findings.reason: Untrusted source: MPLS packet bytes from the network reach mpls_multipath_hash() via mpls_forward() (net/mpls/af_mpls.c:393 -> mpls_select_multipath -> mpls_multipath_hash) and via the route-output path (af_mpls.c:2463); the label stack and the bytes following the bottom label are attacker-supplied. Captured state: the label-stack walk loop captures a raw pointer into the skb head at line 173 (hdr = mpls_hdr(skb) + label_index; mpls_hdr() returns skb_network_header(skb), include/net/mpls.h:25). Interior pull: the loop body then calls pskb_may_pull(skb, mpls_hdr_len + sizeof(struct iphdr)) at line 198 and pskb_may_pull(skb, mpls_hdr_len + sizeof(struct ipv6hdr)) at line 207 — pulls that, on a non-linear skb, run __pskb_pull_tail() and can pskb_expand_head(), freeing/replacing skb->head, exactly the helper behavior that broke the seed's pep_get_sb(). Stale use: hdr is never refetched, yet line 201 derives v4hdr = (const struct iphdr *)(hdr + 1) from the pre-pull hdr and reads v4hdr->version/saddr/daddr/protocol (lines 202-205), and line 211 derives v6hdr = (const struct ipv6hdr *)(hdr + 1) from the same stale hdr and reads v6hdr->saddr/daddr/nexthdr (lines 212-214); those freed-memory values feed jhash_* and determine the selected next hop (mpls_select_multipath: hash % alive), i.e. kernel routing state, and the reads themselves are slab use-after-free reads when the interior pull reallocates the head. Cross-boundary stale state: hdr is loop-carried state captured at the top of the iteration, live across the mid-loop pulls, and dereferenced at the bottom of the same iteration — the seed's pep_get_sb() shape (pointer captured before pskb_may_pull, dereferenced after). Counterevidence checked: the per-iteration recapture at 173 makes earlier iterations safe, and only the bottom-of-stack branch dereferences across the 198/207 pulls; sibling parsers in the same snapshot (ip6_tnl_parse_tlv_enc_lim, ipv6_gso_pull_exthdrs) do refetch after every pull, showing the correct idiom this function lacks. Trigger is conditional on a non-linear skb needing head reallocation at the second pull — the same condition under which the seed bug reproduced under KASAN; no runtime reproducer was built (no network), so this is a source-level data-flow hypothesis with literal line evidence.

candidates.reason: mpls_multipath_hash(): hdr captured at line 173 (pointer into skb head), pskb_may_pull at 198/207 inside the label-walk loop body may free/replace skb->head, then hdr+1 dereferenced at 201-205 and 211-214 without refetch — reported as the finding.

ip6_tnl_parse_tlv_enc_lim(): after each pskb_may_pull (408, 430) hdr is refetched (411) or tel is refetched from skb->data (440); hdr->nexthdr is explicitly cached into 'next' at 425 with a comment about pskb_may_pull invalidation; callers (ip6_gre.c:666-667, ip6_tunnel.c:1326-1328) document the possible reallocation and refetch.

ipv6_gso_pull_exthdrs(): exthdr walk loop; opth is re-derived from skb->data after pskb_may_pull at 58 (line 61) and again after pskb_may_pull at 64 (line 67) before reading opth->nexthdr; no stale pointer survives a pull.
bnep_session() RX loop calls skb_linearize(skb) on the freshly dequeued skb before any parsing in bnep_rx_frame(); no header pointer is captured before the linearize in this scope.
cmtp_session() RX loop: skb_linearize(skb) precedes cmtp_recv_frame() on each dequeued skb; no cross-iteration pointer into skb head is held.
Scan located skb_linearize inside a for(;;) loop in hidp's RX thread; function not deeply read before the search was stopped.
Scan located skb_linearize inside a while(skb_dequeue(...)) loop in rfcomm_process_rx; not deeply read.
Scan located pskb_may_pull(skb, 2) inside the ppp_mp_reconstruct consumer loop in ppp_receive_nonmp; whether any header pointer or cursor captured before the pull is reused after it was not verified.
Scan located __pskb_pull_tail inside RX while-loops (xennet_fill_frags / xennet_receive_skb path); stale-state reuse across iterations not verified.
Scan located skb_unclone inside 'while (eaten < orig_len)' in __strp_recv; whether pointers into skb head captured before it survive was not verified.
Scan located skb_unclone inside the frag-list while-loop of skb_cow_data(); internal invariant not audited (core helper, likely correct, but unverified).
Scan located skb_unclone inside a for-loop in veth's XDP/loopback path; not deeply read.

limitations: Tree-wide scan for pull-inside-loop sites used a brace-matching heuristic over .c files; pulls in single-statement loops, macros, .h files, or where the function-start heuristic failed could be missed.

Of 22 loop-interior pull sites found tree-wide, 12 were triaged; 7 remain classified 'unresolved' (hidp/core.c:1214, rfcomm/core.c:1944, ppp_generic.c:2669, xen-netfront.c:1174/1231, strparser.c:194, skbuff.c:4372, veth.c:977) and were not deeply read.

The reported mpls_multipath_hash() UAF is a static data-flow result: reallocation requires a non-linear skb whose head lacks tailroom at the second pull (lines 198/207); no runtime reproducer or KASAN trace was produced because the snapshot tree cannot be built in this environment.
Whether upstream Linux already fixed mpls_multipath_hash() after this snapshot could not be checked (no network/Git access); the finding reflects the source as present in snapshots/s01.
Only snapshots/s01 was searched, per intent scope; no other snapshot was opened.
